events.description_en: Jehovah forms the first man, Adam, from the dust of the ground. Counting back 1,656 years from the Flood gives 4026 B.C.E., perhaps in the autumn, when the year began on the most ancient calendars.
events.description_ta: 1,656 ஆண்டுகளை முந்தின தேதியாகிய பொ.ச.மு. 2370 உடன் கூட்டினால், ஆதாம் படைக்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டாகிய பொ.ச.மு. 4026-க்கு வருகிறோம். பூர்வ காலண்டர்களில் பெரும்பான்மையானவை இலையுதிர் காலத்தில் தொடங்கினதால், ஆதாம் இலையுதிர் காலத்தில் படைக்கப்பட்டிருக்கலாம்.

events.title_en: Floodwaters fall: the global Deluge begins
events.description_en: In Noah's 600th year the floodwaters begin to fall, destroying the ungodly world; Noah and his family are preserved in the ark. Counting from an autumn year start, the date corresponds roughly to early November.
events.description_ta: 427 ஆண்டுகளை பொ.ச.மு. 1943-உடன் கூட்டினால் பொ.ச.மு. 2370 வருகிறது. இவ்வாறு, நோவாவின் நாளின் ஜலப்பிரளயம் பொ.ச.மு. 2370-ல் தொடங்கினதென்று பைபிளின் கால அட்டவணை காட்டுகிறது.

events.title_en: Covenant made after the Flood (rainbow covenant)

events.title_en: Building of the Tower of Babel; languages confused

events.title_en: Esau marries his first two wives
events.description_en: At 40 years of age, Esau marries two Hittite women, Judith and Basemath, a source of bitterness to Isaac and Rebekah.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1818 B.C.E. Esau marries first two wives Gen. 26:34

events.description_en: Ishmael dies at the age of 137.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1795 B.C.E. Death of Ishmael Gen. 25:17
After that he lived another 48 years, dying in 1795 B.C.E. at the age of 137.

events.description_en: After receiving Isaac's blessing, Jacob flees from his brother Esau, who wants to kill him, and travels to his relatives in Haran in Paddan-aram.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1781 B.C.E. Jacob flees to Haran; his vision at Bethel Gen. 28:2, 13, 19
Jacob fled from his murderous brother Esau in 1781 B.C.E., traveling to Haran in Paddan-aram

events.description_en: On the way to Haran, Jacob sees a vision of a stairway to heaven and Jehovah confirms to him the promises made to Abraham. Jacob names the place Bethel.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1781 B.C.E. Jacob flees to Haran; his vision at Bethel Gen. 28:2, 13, 19

events.description_en: After seven years of service to Laban, Jacob is given Leah and then Rachel as wives.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1774 B.C.E. Jacob marries Leah and Rachel Gen. 29:23-30

events.description_en: Rachel, after years of barrenness, gives birth to Joseph, Jacob's 11th son.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1767 B.C.E. Birth of Joseph Gen. 30:23, 24

events.title_en: Jacob returns to Canaan from Haran
events.description_en: After 20 years with Laban, Jacob leaves Haran with his family and livestock to return to Canaan.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: 1761 B.C.E. Jacob returns to Canaan from Haran Gen. 31:18, 41

events.title_en: Jacob wrestles an angel and is named Israel
events.title_ta: யாக்கோபு தேவதூதரோடு போராடுகிறார்; இஸ்ரவேல் என்று பெயரிடப்படுகிறார்
events.description_en: On his way back, Jacob wrestles with an angel and will not let go until he is blessed; his name is changed to Israel.

sources.title_en: Study Number 3—Measuring Events in the Stream of Time
sources.quote_en: c. 1761 B.C.E. Jacob wrestles angel; is named Israel Gen. 32:24-28
